senses.gloss: (denom. of סוֹף) to cut the ends of, trim; to graze.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 6:3">Naz. VI, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Nazir 39a">39ᵃ</cite>) <he>או שסי׳ כל שהוא</he> (Bart. <he>ששִׂיפְשֵׂף</he>, cmp. <cite ref="U01711"><he>שָׂפָה</he></cite>) or trimmed his hair ever so little. Ib. 39ᵇ. Y. ib. VI, 55ᵃ bot. <he>לרבות את המְסַפְסֵף</he> to include (in the prohibition) him who trims his hair.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 6:5:2">Y. B. Kam. VI, 5ᶜ</cite> top <he>סִיפְסְפָה אבניו</he> if the fire grazed his stones.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 6:5:2">Ib.</cite> <he>או מְסַפְסֵף והולך וכ׳</he> or it went on grazing (objects) even to a mile’s distance; v. <cite ref="O00936"><he>סִכְסֵךְ</he> II</cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 4:4:5">Y. Bets. IV, 62ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אין מְסַפְסְפִין אותה באור</he> you must not trim the ends of a wick by burning it (Bab.
